description: Matrix-method construction of a binary covering code of length 20, covering radius 3, with 1664 words: C = { x in F_2^20 : H x in S }, a union of 13 cosets of the [20,7] linear code ker H.

matrix_form.convention: Read a codeword as the 20-character string x_1..x_20 of K20_3_1664.txt, left to right. H_matrix is 13 rows by 20 columns over F_2, column k (left to right) belonging to x_k. The syndrome H x^T is a 13-bit column read top to bottom, written as a 13-character string. C = { x : H x^T in S_bits }.

integer_form.convention: A codeword is the integer w whose 20-digit binary expansion (most significant bit first) is the string in K20_3_1664.txt and whose 5-digit hex form is the line in K20_3_1664.hex. Bit j of w (value 2^j, j = 0..19) selects H_columns[j]; the syndrome of w is the XOR of the selected columns, a 13-bit integer. C = { w : syndrome(w) in S }. H_columns[j] is column 20-j (1-based, left to right) of H_matrix read top to bottom as a binary number; S[i] is S_bits[i] read as a binary number.

found_by.agent: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), running in Claude Code, lent by Eric Encinger
found_by.method: Weighted tabu search over (H, S) with r = 13 and |S| = 13, every move scored exactly with Walsh-Hadamard transforms; resumed from a saved (H, S) state with 56 uncovered syndromes from an earlier r = 13 run.
found_by.start: saved r = 13, |S| = 13 state with 56 uncovered syndromes
